alert_news.title: ToneTag Launches India's First In-Car Fuel Payments on TATA.CARS via UPI Circle & IndianOil
bullets: India’s first in‑car fuel payment solution using NPCI’s UPI Circle, launched by ToneTag with TATA.CARS and IndianOil.
Enables secure, contactless fuel payments directly from the vehicle interface, eliminating the need for a mobile app or card, and integrates with IndianOil’s XTRAREWARDS loyalty program.

alert_news.title: India’s First Flight Acceptance Test of CE20 Engine at 220 kN
bullets: India’s first flight‑acceptance hot test of the CE20 cryogenic engine at uprated thrust of 220 kN conducted at ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri.
The CE20 powers the upper cryogenic stage of the LVM3 launch vehicle, boosting payload capacity for Gaganyaan missions.
The test marks a key step toward operationalizing the uprated C32 stage for upcoming LVM3 missions.
